name: help-scout-mcp-server
description: Connect Claude to Help Scout with full read coverage: conversations, customers, organizations, reports, metadata, and Docs through a compact three-tool surface.
long_description:
Connect your AI assistant to Help Scout for support investigation and account-level analysis, read-only unless you turn writes on.

**How it works:**
The extension advertises three tools that together reach all 55 supported read operations across the Help Scout Mailbox v2 and Docs v1 APIs:
• **search_help_scout** finds operations by intent ("customer conversation history", "happiness report")
• **describe_help_scout** loads the full input schemas for the operations you selected
• **read_help_scout** executes one operation with schema-matched arguments

**Read coverage:**
• Conversations: search, summaries, full threads, attachments, original email source
• Customers and organizations: profiles, contact channels, membership, conversation history
• Reports: company, conversations, productivity, happiness, users, channels, Docs
• Metadata: inboxes, custom fields, folders, routing, tags, users, teams, saved replies, workflows, webhooks
• Docs: sites, collections, categories, articles, revisions, redirects

**Write support (off by default):**
Enable writes in settings and a fourth tool, **write_help_scout**, appears with 11 tier-1 conversation operations: draft replies, internal notes, status, assign and unassign, tags, custom fields, snooze and unsnooze, and moving a conversation between inboxes. None of those email anyone. Enable customer-visible writes as well and two more operations become reachable, sendReply and publishDraft, each of which emails the customer and demands per-call confirmation naming the operation and the target conversation. Deletes and admin configuration writes are not exposed. Any write accepts a dry run that reports the exact request without contacting Help Scout.

**Security:**
• OAuth2 Client Credentials authentication
• Read-only by default: both write settings are off unless you turn them on
• Optional message content redaction to reduce context size
• Built-in caching and rate-limit handling

app_id.title: Help Scout App ID
app_id.description: Your App ID from Help Scout My Apps

app_secret.title: Help Scout App Secret
app_secret.description: Your App Secret from Help Scout My Apps

default_inbox_id.title: Default Inbox ID (Optional)
default_inbox_id.description: Default inbox for scoped searches - improves LLM context. Inbox IDs are auto-discovered on connect. Leave empty to search all inboxes.

docs_api_key.title: Docs API Key (Optional)
docs_api_key.description: Help Scout Docs API key for knowledge base tools

docs_base_url.title: Docs API Base URL
docs_base_url.description: Help Scout Docs API v1 base URL

redact_message_content.title: Redact Message Content
redact_message_content.description: Replace message bodies with placeholders in responses

enable_writes.title: Enable Write Operations
enable_writes.description: Add the write_help_scout tool with 11 conversation write operations: draft replies, internal notes, status, assign and unassign, tags, custom fields, snooze and unsnooze, and moving a conversation between inboxes. None of these email anyone. Leave off for a read-only install.

enable_customer_visible_writes.title: Enable Customer-Visible Writes (Sends Email)
enable_customer_visible_writes.description: Also allow sendReply and publishDraft. Both email the customer immediately and cannot be recalled. Requires Enable Write Operations as well, and every such call must carry confirmation naming the operation and the target conversation. Leave off unless you intend the assistant to be able to email customers.

cache_ttl.title: Cache TTL (seconds)
cache_ttl.description: How long to cache API responses

tools.name: search_help_scout
tools.description: Search 55 Help Scout read operations by user intent (conversations, customers, organizations, inboxes, users, reports, Docs articles, attachments). Returns matching operation names and descriptions.

tools.name: describe_help_scout
tools.description: Return the complete input schemas for selected Help Scout read operations named by search_help_scout.

tools.name: read_help_scout
tools.description: Execute one Help Scout read operation using arguments that match its loaded schema. All operations are read-only.

tools.name: write_help_scout
tools.description: Execute one Help Scout conversation write operation. Appears only when writes are enabled in settings. Customer-visible operations additionally require the customer-visible setting and per-call confirmation naming the operation and target conversation.

prompts.name: search-last-7-days
prompts.description: Find recent conversations from the last 7 days
prompts.text:
To search for conversations from the last 7 days:
1. Run the getServerTime operation via read_help_scout to get current timestamp
2. Calculate date 7 days ago
3. Run searchConversations via read_help_scout with createdAfter parameter
4. Optionally get details by running getConversationSummary or getThreads via read_help_scout

prompts.name: find-urgent-tags
prompts.text:
To find urgent conversations:
1. Run the getServerTime operation via read_help_scout
2. Search for conversations with tags like 'urgent', 'priority', 'high-priority', 'critical'
3. Run searchConversations via read_help_scout with tag parameter
4. Consider running getConversationSummary via read_help_scout for quick assessment

prompts.name: list-inbox-activity
prompts.text:
To monitor inbox activity:
1. Run the getServerTime operation via read_help_scout
2. Calculate timestamp N hours ago
3. Run searchConversations via read_help_scout with inboxId and createdAfter
4. Analyze results for activity patterns and status breakdown
